translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Da Kx Na-alvztrngr Taetus Leplz Nedeng
A' nim, kx Taetus, na-alvztr-ngrn leplz nemqng nqmq kx takitrde leplz kcng tzsuti drtwrdr nzvz-nqblq-krdr nzalvztrngr angidrng.

Pibz badr lrtzlvzng amrlx na-aclve-lzbqng, x nayrplapxng, x nqmq krdr natakitrde leplz nzamatq-krdr nidr. X mou natu-amqnging mz nzalvztrngr angidrng, mz nzmrlzti-krdr leplz x mz ale-krdr da kxtubq, kxmule-esz' da kx prtz.
X pi-kzpz badr blang kx nzmu na-amrluelr Gct mz nzmncngr kxtr. A' bzkq nzrpikiting x nzrmnq-zlwzng. A' na-alvztr-ngrdr iledrng kx namrlzti-zvzlr ncblo ngrdrng x doa nedrng mz nqmq kxtubq.
X mou, na-alvztr-ngrdr olvz lcng kx nayrplapxng x nzmnc-krdr natr, x nawz-angidrng mrnyzdr. X naokatrlr leplz x namnclzbzng mz ncblo ngrdr, murde leplz kxtrnzrlxngitiung ma tzpibqtilr natq Gct.
X rngidrlvz-ngrbz mz ncblo x obla nemqng kx nayrplapxng mz nzaclve-lzbq-krdr, murde ma tzvz-rbrng mz nzmncngr kx trtakitrdeu kxnzrlxngiting.
Taetus, nanginibzme lrpzki mz leplz nemqng mz da amrlx, mz nzale-krm da kxmrlz x mz nzalvztr-angidr-krmqng, murde na-amatqlr nim.
Tubqpwz mz nzycmne-krmqng amrlx, murde enqmi rgung ma tzmctrplr da kxtrka bagu. A' drtqdr namya murde sa narblxbz badr nzpibqti-krdr nigu.
X pi-kzpz mz kxnzawz-nrbalqng kxnzrlxngiting kx navz-nqblq-zvzlr natq kxnzetu rdrng, murde na-abrtzlvzlr nidr mz da amrlx kcng nartrngztibzlr. A' bzkq nzxpqbrlr-ngrdr kxnzetu rdrng.
X bzkq nzpnatibzlr dztudrng x trau scdrng. A' nabrti drtwr kxetu rdr nidr, murde nzmrlzkr nqmq krdr na-aelwapx-ngrde kx nzalvztr-krgu ngi da angidr x navectrple leplz mz Mevalu rgu.
Da zpwxtx. Nqmq kr nigu kxnzrlxngiting natubq, murde leplz nalxngitilr Gct kc tqaelwapxpe-ngrde zmrlz ngrde kxmyalz mz nzatwzlr-krmle Jiszs, mz nzarlapx-krde leplz amrlx kcng nalxngitilr nide.
Dekc tqalvztrngr Jiszs kx nayrplapxku x natubqku mz nzmnc-krgu mz nrlc. X na-axtxbzku nqmq krgung kxtrka x nzmrlz-krm bagu alwx x dalr nrlc.
X mzli ka tqobqtipx-ngrgu nzyzlu-krm Mevalu Jiszs mz nzmyalzkr zluli rde nzngini-krde Gct x Mevalu rgu, namnc-nqblqku nzmncngr lcng.

Murde rlrpx-lzbqngr Jiszs nzbz-krde nigu, murde na-arlapxle nigu x trnamnclzpepwzkuu mz zmatq ngr alwx, a' nzmnc-krgu natubq x nanginigu leplz nedeng kcng drtqdr tqvq mz nzale-krgu da kxmrlz mz nzobq-krde.

Taetus, alvztrngr leplz nemqng kx navz-nqblqlr nqmq lcng tqmrlz. Apqtrpz drtwrdr x lc-apqbz leplz kcng tzpxtxpx-ngrdr natqmqng. Murde bzkq kx naxpqbrlr-ngrde zmatq ngrm. Murde natq kc tqkabzme badr vzpxm mz nzalvztr-krgr nigr aposol.
